Smithers ships as a layered family of `@smthrs/*` Effect packages. Only the bottom **Hosts & Platforms** layer touches OS, Node, Bun, Cloudflare, or browser APIs; every upper layer runs portably through injected Effect services.

<SvgDiagram
  title="Layered architecture of @smthrs packages"
  caption="Upper layers depend only on Effect services. Platform-specific code lives exclusively inside @smthrs/platform-node, platform-bun, platform-browser, platform-cloudflare, kernel, sandbox, and jj."
  svg={sdkLayersSvg}
  text={sdkLayersText}
/>

Packages marked **workspace-private** link to contributor references and cannot be installed from npm.

## Install

Install the full 1.0 release-candidate engine barrel from npm under `@next`:

```bash
npm install @smthrs/flows@next effect
```

Install any individual published package the same way (`npm install @smthrs/<name>@next effect`).

## Reading these pages

- **Source of truth:** published pages mirror each package's colocated `docs/api.md` or `docs/reference/` files.
- **Public imports:** import from the package root (`@smthrs/cli`) or a subpath explicitly declared in its export map.
- **Blocked internals:** `internal/*` and nested `*/index` subpaths are never public.

## Platform support

See the [RC support matrix](/docs/reference/support-matrix/) for certified runtime boundaries. Node.js and Bun run durably through `NodeRuntime` and `BunRuntime`, storing state in local SQLite or PostgreSQL (`SMITHERS_POSTGRES_URL` or `DATABASE_URL`).

Browsers run durable flows through `BrowserRuntime` in `@smthrs/platform-browser`, backed by SQLite in OPFS inside a dedicated worker. A Web Lock elects one leader per origin: with all tabs closed, execution pauses, and opening a new tab resumes unfinished runs from that browser profile's store. Clearing browser storage resets the store, and separate profiles or devices keep separate stores. No other SQL client is a supported durable browser store.
